        <div className="content-stretch flex flex-col items-start pb-px relative shrink-0 w-[45px]" data-name="Frame" data-node-id="6209:2247">
          {showTrailing && <HeaderTrailingAccessories className="content-stretch flex items-start justify-end relative shrink-0 w-full" />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

    </div>
